approach: Actual explanatory passages and questions inspected; original scenarios, wording, data and solutions. No private OU text or pages redistributed.

references.source: Teaching Standard and Practice v1.12; fixed illustrated M101 opening chapter v0.4
references.fit: Substantive purpose-led introduction, readable connected reasoning, mathematical typography, meaningful captions and mixed practice. Assessment questions preserve independent work rather than inserting worked answers into the public task.

passages.Q01: U08 §§8.5–8.11: phase and rates, restoring parameter, energy and damping, controlled driving
passages.Q02: U09 §§9.1–9.3, 9.5, 9.9–9.12: phase propagation, superposition, fixed ends, tests that can fail
passages.Q03: U10 §§10.2–10.8: normal angles, boundary frequency, real/virtual images and signed lens model
passages.Q04: U10 §§10.9–10.13: power-area-time, controlled ratios, optical versus recorded resolution
passages.Q05: U08 §§8.12–8.15 and U10 §§10.14–10.16: sparse sampling, source/control records, distinguishing models and checked computation

references.fit: All required methods already taught; earlier algebra, energy, CSV, functions, loops and plots reused. TMA02 establishes open-book independence and private chat marking handover.

references.source: Private supplied OU MST124 Unit 4 Trigonometry
references.inspected: §1.4 printed pp18–19 (inverse trig); §2.3 pp34–36 (cosine/sine periodicity); Example 6 pp37–38 and Activity 17 p39 (values, symmetry and periodic solutions)
references.fit: Reasoned angle selection, period and symmetry precede numerical evaluation. OU questions isolate mathematical fluency; this assessment combines those skills with already taught physics and asks for greater independence. No close number-swapped adaptations.

references.source: OpenStax College Physics 2e Chapter 16 Problems & Exercises
references.fit: Cycle quantities; amplitude-energy relationships; wave speed/wavelength; fixed-end node/antinode interpretation; power/intensity. Original task combines fluent calculations with explanatory and diagnostic steps. Beats, pendulums and untaught calculus excluded.

references.source: OpenStax College Physics 2e §16.8 Forced Oscillations and Resonance
references.inspected: Driving, energy input, frequency response and damping discussion
references.fit: Qualitative controlled comparison and steady energy account; no unsupported claim that every damped displacement peak is exactly the undamped natural frequency.

references.source: OpenStax College Physics 2e §16.11 Energy in Waves: Intensity
references.inspected: Intensity definition and Example 16.9(a), energy from intensity, area and duration
references.fit: Same taught dimensional chain; task adds a mixed ratio and a bounded inference about recorded counts.

references.source: OpenStax College Physics 2e Chapter 25 Problems & Exercises
references.fit: Normal-angle refraction, index relations and thin-lens real/virtual geometry. Original question uses separate boundary and lens arrangements; no dioptre-power prerequisite.

gaps: No matching supplied private OU physics/waves/optics assessment available; public undergraduate physics sources supplement the private mathematical comparator.
